pageChanges.before:
The Sponsor Hub is the central resource for managing your organization’s participation in the event. Through the Hub, you can submit a custom Delegate Profiling Question, update your company information, register your onsite attendees, complete the business meeting selection process, review key dates and deliverables, and access important event information and resources.

Sponsor Hub login credentials are provided by your Operations Lead in their welcome email, which is typically sent 8–10 weeks prior to the event start date.
